name: Cell Projection of Tetrahedral Meshes (Data Transfer Optimization)
aliases: Display lists and vertex arrays for tetrahedral meshes
Vertex array range extension for tetrahedral meshes
definition: Approach to overcome data transfer bottleneck between CPU and graphics board by using a view-independent description of the unstructured mesh, building a fixed set of data in preprocessing reused every frame.
summary: Cell Projection of Tetrahedral Meshes optimizes CPU-to-GPU data transfer by pre-defining geometry in fixed arrays, unlike projected tetrahedra which produces a continuous triangle stream.
